q-0034.answer:
Here are relevant duas from our collection:

• Dua for safety on the journey (Dua travel-4)
اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ
O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that are pleasing to You
(Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa wa minal-'amali ma tarda)
Source: Muslim 1342

• Dua when leaving home (Dua travel-1)
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might nor power except with Allah
(Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alallahi la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah)
Source: Sunan Abu Dawud 5095, Tirmidhi 3426

Transliteration: Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa wa minal-'amali ma tarda. Dua travel-5: Dua when mounting a vehicle. Arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ. Transliteration: Subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun. English: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it by our efforts. Surely, to our Lord we will return.. Urdu: پاک ہے وہ جس نے اسے ہمارے لیے مسخر کیا اور ہم خود اس پر قابو نہ پا سکتے تھے، اور ہم اپنے رب کی طرف لوٹنے والے ہیں۔. Source: Quran 43:13-14

Dua travel-2: Dua for travel (Surah Al-Mulk). Arabic: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. Transliteration: Tabarakalladhi biyadihil-mulku wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. English: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent.. Urdu: بڑی برکت والا ہے وہ جس کے ہاتھ میں بادشاہی ہے اور وہ ہر چیز پر قادر ہے۔. Source: Quran 67:1

Dua travel-3: Dua during travel — patience and gratitude. Arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ. Transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakallati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardah. English: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve.. q-0409.answer:
Surah Al-Qasas (28) — The Stories · 88 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Musa from beginning to end and how Allah began His revelation to him and spoke with him
• You were not living among the people of Madyan reciting Our Ayat to them, when you started to tell about Our Prophet Shu'ayb and what he said to his people and how they responded.
• You – O Muhammad – were not on the western side of the mountain where Allah spoke to Musa from the tree which was to the east of it, in the valley.
• You were not present then, but Allah has revealed this to you.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0496.answer:
Surah Al-Ahqaf (46) — The Dunes · 35 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• No one is more misguided than those who invoke idols instead of Allah, asking them for things that they cannot give – until the Day of Judgment.
• When they saw the punishment coming towards them, they thought it to be clouds full of rain.
• Evidence for Life after Death
• The disbelievers are distracted from what is intended for them.
• This is the torment that you called for saying, "Bring to us what you promise us if you should be of the truthful.

Surah Al-Qamar (54) — The Moon · 55 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Before the torment struck his people, he warned them of Allah's torment and punishment.
• We only command a thing once, without needing to repeat the command; and whatever We command comes to existence faster than the blinking of an eye without any delay, not even for an instant.
• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.
